name: Marina Nabokina career
content: Marina Nabokina's career highlights: Began modeling in 2020/2021 at age 19-20; Signed with Mavrin Models as 'Mary Nabokova' (2021-2022), then left over unpaid wages and unfavorable terms; Rebuilt her brand under her real name on Instagram and Telegram

name: Marina Nabokina personal
content: About Marina Nabokina: Born December 24, 2000 in Russia (sources cite Blagoveshchensk or Irkutsk); speaks Russian and English. An animal lover now based between Bali and Dubai; in a long-term relationship with a businessman.

name: Marina Nabokina quotes
content: Things Marina Nabokina has said: 𝓈𝓉𝒶𝓎 𝒽𝑒𝓇𝑒. 𝓌𝒾𝓉𝒽 𝓂𝑒 🥀 (her Instagram bio)

name: Marina Nabokina voice
content: Marina Nabokina's speaking style: Very little interview material; on camera she is soft-spoken with a Russian accent, posting romantic, poetic captions in Russian and English. Quiet and intimate rather than chatty.
